# Dialog script for clusterpoints automatically generated

{
    name	clusterpoints
    script	clusterpoints
    label	"Cluster Points"

    help {
	""
    }

    inputlabel	1	"Points To Cluster"
    inputlabel	2	"Rest Position"
    inputlabel	3	"Sub-Network Input #3"
    inputlabel	4	"Sub-Network Input #4"

    parm {
        name    "attrib_name"
        label   "Output Attribute"
        type    string
        joinnext
        default { "cluster" }
        range   { 0 1 }
        parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
    }
    parm {
        name    "cluster_output"
        label   "Output"
        type    ordinal
        joinnext
        default { "0" }
        menu {
            "clusterpoints" "Cluster Points "
            "averagepoints" "Average Points"
            "both"          "Both"
            "boxes"         "Boxes"
        }
        range   { 0 1 }
    }
    parm {
        name    "color_output"
        label   "Color Output"
        type    ordinal
        nolabel
        default { "color" }
        menu {
            "off"   "Points"
            "on"    "Colored Particles"
            "color" "Colored Points"
        }
        range   { 0 1 }
    }
    parm {
        name    "cluster_filter"
        label   "Cluster Filter"
        type    string
        default { "*" }
        range   { 0 1 }
    }
    multiparm {
        name    "num_controls"
        label    "Control Attributes"
        default 1
        parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }

        parm {
            name    "control_attrib#"
            label   "Control Attribute #"
            type    string
            joinnext
            default { "P" }
            range   { 0 1 }
        }
        parm {
            name    "control_weight#"
            label   "Weight #"
            type    float
            default { "1" }
            range   { 0! 10 }
        }
    }

    group {
        name    "folder0"
        label   "Cluster Settings"

        parm {
            name    "buildclusters"
            label   "Build Clusters"
            type    toggle
            default { "1" }
            range   { 0 1 }
        }
        parm {
            name    "num_clusters"
            label   "Clusters"
            type    integer
            default { "10" }
            disablewhen "{ buildclusters == 0 }"
            range   { 1! 100 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
        parm {
            name    "random_seed"
            label   "Seed"
            type    integer
            default { "0" }
            disablewhen "{ buildclusters == 0 }"
            range   { 0 100 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
        parm {
            name    "iterations"
            label   "Refinement Iterations"
            type    integer
            default { "50" }
            disablewhen "{ buildclusters == 0 }"
            range   { 0 100 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
        parm {
            name    "threshold_attrib"
            label   "Threshold Attribute"
            type    string
            joinnext
            default { "" }
            disablewhen "{ buildclusters == 0 }"
            range   { 0 1 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
        parm {
            name    "threshold_weight"
            label   "Weight"
            type    float
            default { "1" }
            disablewhen "{ threshold_attrib == \"\" } { buildclusters == 0 }"
            range   { 0! 10 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
        parm {
            name    "initial_time_thresh"
            label   "Initial Threshold"
            type    float
            default { "1" }

            range   { 0 10 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
        parm {
            name    "time_thresh"
            label   "Goal Threshold"
            type    float
            default { "0.25" }
            disablewhen "{ threshold_attrib == \"\" } { buildclusters == 0 }"
            range   { 0 10 }
            parmtag { "autoscope" "0000000000000000" }
        }
    }

    group {
        name    "folder0_1"

        parm {
